tools.name: generate_sepa_xml
tools.description: Generate SEPA XML (pain.001 or pain.008) with XSD + business validation. Included in the multi and business subscriptions (monthly quota); demo callers are limited to 2 transactions per file. Party addresses are optional and structured only: street_name, building_number, post_code, town_name, countr

tools.name: validate_sepa_xml
tools.description: Validate a SEPA XML payload against XSD and business rules.

tools.name: generate_mt103
tools.description: Generate a SWIFT MT103 (Single Customer Credit Transfer) text message. Included in the business subscription only (monthly quota). Charges use the SWIFT :71A: codes SHA/BEN/OUR verbatim.

tools.name: list_supported_versions
tools.description: List supported ISO 20022 formats and versions.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "generate_sepa_xml" is 849 chars, far longer than this server's median (123). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
